summary: Compass Diversified Holdings (CODI) filed an 8-K to announce a scheduled quarterly distribution on its Series A, B, and C preferred shares for the period April 30 to July 30, 2026, payable July 30, 2026 to holders of record July 15, 2026. No M&A, tender, restructuring, or other special situation occurs; this is a routine dividend declaration. The filing falls under Items 8.01 (Other Events) and 9.01 (Exhibits) with no transactional terms, premium, or strategic action. As a standard ongoing capital return to preferred holders via regular periodic distribution, it does not constitute a special situation.
